personality_one_liner: A clinical, high-contrast, Apple Health-inspired cognitive operating system where vibrant data metrics pop against pristine white space.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-native whitespace. Large margins around distinct cards. Health rings demand breathing room, never cluster them tightly.

do's: Use heavy frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Apply subtle glass on sticky headers when scrolling through the Cognitive Timeline.
Use glass effect behind floating actions like 'New Capture'.
dont's: Do not apply glass to individual timeline cards.
Do not use glass inside the Knowledge Graph canvas (keep nodes solid).

screens.name: Timeline
screens.purpose: Chronological life-replay of cognitive captures, acting as the app's home.

states.empty: Clean workspace image with a subtle 'Log your first thought' CTA.
states.error: Minimal text 'Unable to sync timeline' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky large title 'Timeline'. Scrollable list of 'TimelineEvent' cards. Each card uses surfaceSecondary with md radius, displaying time, concise text, and a GravityScore badge. Floating 'Add Note' pill button anchored bottom-right above the glass tab bar.

screens.name: Graph
screens.purpose: Living Knowledge Graph with animated nodes and thumb-zone navigation.

states.empty: Abstract geometry image suggesting unconnected dots.

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive canvas. Black or ultra-dark canvas inverse for maximum contrast if preferred, OR stark white with stark black nodes. Bottom sheet (glass) overlapping the canvas for node details/filters. Pan/zoom via gestures.

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a concept, showing its Idea Evolution, AI Council responses, and Gravity Score.
screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: Core note text (large Geist text). Below: 'Memory Gravity' metric (large mono font). Middle: Horizontal scroll of 'AgentResponse' cards (colored by agent). Bottom: 'Decision DNA' lineage (vertical stepped timeline).

screens.name: Memory Health
screens.purpose: Apple-Health-like dashboard for knowledge quality, density, and duplicate risk.

states.empty: Zeroed rings with prompt to capture more.

screens.layout: Grid of cards. Top hero card: Large concentric 'HealthRings' (using the agent colors for distinct metrics). Below: 2-column grid of single-metric cards (e.g., Doc Freshness, Unlinked Knowledge). Use 'Space Grotesk' for big numbers. High contrast, clean layout.

screens.name: Genome (Cognitive Twin)
screens.purpose: AI reasoning hub that predicts next actions based on user history and ROI.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty mind map.

screens.layout: Centered layout with generous padding. Large text predicting 'What you would probably do next'. Knowledge ROI listed as neat, flat rows with clear success/revenue metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Apple Health-like' clinical aesthetic: Use pristine white space (#FFFFFF) heavily, contrasting with vibrant, specific accent colors assigned to the 5 AI agents.
Implement the 'HealthRing' component using React Native Reanimated/Skia to ensure smooth fill animations upon mounting.
For the Memory Health Dashboard, ensure large metric numbers use the 'monoFontFamily' (Space Grotesk or similar system mono) to emphasize data, surrounded by generous 'xl' and '2xl' padding.
The Knowledge Graph screen should use pan/zoom gesture handlers. Keep navigation in the thumb-zone by using a translucent bottom sheet for node details rather than full-screen modals.
Ensure 'Decision DNA' and 'Idea Evolution' lineage visualizers use strict vertical lines (1pt or 2pt width) connecting nodes, resembling Git-commit histories but styled cleanly without clutter.
Always apply frosted glass (expo-blur or expo-glass-effect) to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to provide depth.
Do not use banned colors (indigo, blue, purple) as requested by the global persona. Use the specific custom tokens (agentResearch, agentArchitect, etc.) defined in the color palette.
Ensure all primary 'Add Note' or interactive CTA buttons sit above the safe area or tab bar so they are easily reachable.
